description: Add the review-only pass form and asynchronous typed adapter call. Require trimmed reviewer identity and workspace-relative evidence, snapshot submitted values, and refresh the review list after success.
acceptance_criteria: RED/GREEN tests prove required fields, exact pass payload, busy locking, success and recovery messages, cancellation, wrong or late result rejection, sanitization, and bounded rendering. No agent-callable headless approval path exists.

title: Reduce Bubble Tea to the human review workspace
description: Remove Setup, Work, and Workspace Health screens and their broad operation dependencies. Keep a focused review list with selection, refresh, resize, cancellation, safe errors, bounded rendering, and NO_COLOR support.
acceptance_criteria: Focused TUI tests prove only review behavior is reachable; list loading, j/k and arrow navigation, refresh, quit, resize, cancellation, stale-result rejection, safe DTO rendering, and 60/100-column bounds work without exposing raw Beads, Git, or credential output.

title: Explore multi-wave scheduling and host launcher adapters
description: Explore dependency-aware execution waves and optional host launcher or observer adapters only after the one-wave prepared-workspace flow has passed human E2E.
design: Keep this deferred and host-neutral. Any future scheduler must preserve single-repository write ownership, explicit integration gates, durable state, safe resume and cancellation semantics, and no implicit Beads claiming. Reassess real usage after smt-5w0.11.7 rather than extending the first release spec now.
acceptance_criteria: A later proposal documents validated needs, adapter boundaries, wave semantics, resume and cancellation behavior, safety constraints, compatibility impact, and a focused delivery plan. No launcher or multi-wave behavior is added to the first feature-workspace release.
